name: build_wow_character_url
description: Resolve a WoW CN character from character/server or player/class using this skill's TSV tables, then build the official character page URL.

title.description: WeChat chat title to send to. Defaults to the inbound chat.

server.description: Chinese server name or realm slug when known.

player.description: Canonical player name or alias, e.g. 吴松竹 or 吴工.

class_name.description: Class/job to resolve under the player, e.g. 战士.
